cards.title: One public product
cards.body: The only offer linked anywhere is the Crown Strategy recorded course on Superprofile, posted 4× in your last 17 Telegram posts. Your bio says Mentor | Coach, but there's no application, calendar or mentorship page.

cards.title: Daily lives, no next step
cards.body: You stream almost daily (3.5K–8.7K views per live) and your last 10 YouTube uploads average ~14.3K views. The call to action is always "join Telegram" or "msg me", so the warmest viewers have nowhere official to go.

cards.title: DMs are where the fakes are
cards.body: Your Telegram description warns about fake channels, yet VIP access runs through "DM @tradingdivaa". An official, branded application page gives your audience one safe place to buy from you.

mechanism.title: The idea
mechanism.body: Keep the course as the entry product. Add a mentorship tier that people apply for. Every live, video and pinned post points to one official page, where they apply, get qualified and book a call. Before the call, a short email sequence answers the questions you'd otherwise repeat in DMs.

cards.title: Too many concepts, no system
cards.body: Order blocks, FVG, BOS, CHoCH, liquidity. You've watched it all, but on a live chart it still doesn't come together.

cards.title: Good setups, bad execution
cards.body: You see the move, then enter late, size too big or exit on emotion. The strategy isn't the problem. The process is.

cards.title: No one checks your trades
cards.body: Without a journal and someone who reviews it, the same mistake repeats for months without you noticing.

mechanism.title: The Trading Diva method
mechanism.body: One path instead of twenty playlists: understand where liquidity sits (SMC), wait for the Crown Strategy setup, execute it live with a fixed risk plan, and write every trade into a journal that gets reviewed. The free YouTube content teaches the concepts. The mentorship is where they turn into your process.

preCallEmails.subject: You're booked: here's what happens next
preCallEmails.previewText: Your call with the Trading Diva team is confirmed
preCallEmails.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Your call is booked for {{call_time}} (IST). The link is in your calendar invite.

Two things before we talk:
1. Keep this time free. We hold a limited number of mentorship calls each week.
2. If you have a trading journal, even a messy one, keep it open during the call.

One safety note: we will never ask you for money over Telegram DM or WhatsApp. The only official links come from this email address, @tradingdiva_ on Instagram and the Trading Diva YouTube channel.

See you soon,
Team Trading Diva

preCallEmails.subject: Why concepts alone don't make you consistent
preCallEmails.previewText: You've watched the SMC videos. Here's the missing piece.
preCallEmails.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

If you've watched the SMC series on YouTube, you already know what an order block, an FVG or a liquidity sweep is.

Knowing it doesn't make you consistent on a live chart. Two things do: waiting for one specific setup, and a process that shows you your own mistakes.

That's what the mentorship is built around. One setup (Crown), a fixed risk plan, and a journal that actually gets reviewed.

On the call we'll look at where your process breaks today.

Team Trading Diva

preCallEmails.subject: "Isn't all of this on YouTube for free?"
preCallEmails.previewText: Mostly, yes. Here's the honest difference.
preCallEmails.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

A fair question we hear a lot: isn't everything free on YouTube?

Most of the concepts are, and they'll stay free. What YouTube can't do is look at your trades, tell you which mistake you repeat, and keep you on one plan when the market gets loud.

If you can do that on your own, you don't need a mentorship, and we'll tell you so on the call.

If you can't yet, that's exactly the gap the mentorship covers.

Team Trading Diva

preCallEmails.subject: What the call is (and isn't)
preCallEmails.previewText: No trade tips, no promises, a straight conversation
preCallEmails.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

So you know what to expect:

- The call takes about {{call_length}} minutes [CONFIRM].
- We'll ask about your experience, markets, risk and journal.
- If the mentorship fits, we'll explain what's included and the investment [CONFIRM].
- If it doesn't fit, we'll tell you and point you to the free resources.

What the call is not: there are no trade calls, no signals and no promises of returns. Trading involves real risk of loss.

Team Trading Diva
